Synopsis:
    US equity futures rebounded premarket after a rough week, with investors awaiting a key CPI print. Oracle surged on strong AI-driven earnings; Nvidia edged higher. Headwinds remain: elevated Treasury yields near 4.94% (highest since 2023), a hotter-than-expected PPI reading, surging energy prices (Brent above $104, diesel above $6/gallon for the first time ever), and ongoing Middle East conflict. Rate expectations are unstable. One money manager warns the Fed risks a 1970s-style inflation repeat if it fails to act. Adobe fell on weak guidance; ACV Auctions surged on a Copart acquisition deal.
